deviations.what: **e2e-verified 2026-08-01** (scripts/e2e-smoke.mjs interaction, transpiled backend + real browser): one keyboard step on the Slider carries the value into the backend, the round-trip recomposes the Panel width and the Panel really renders at 99% - the imperative setWidth is fully replaced. Residual (nothing headless can assert): the visual GridList reflow inside the resized panel.

GridList with a grid:GridBoxLayout (boxMinWidth 17rem) and a GridListItem template (VBox + FlexItemData, Title, Label). The 27 items are inlined from model/items.json; the template binds {TITLE}/{SUBTITLE} 1:1.
